verdict.rationale: Sentry documents ingesting OpenTelemetry traces and logs through OTLP endpoints. It also offers a trace explorer for span data and dashboards that span error and performance data, so traces and logs land in one platform. Nothing in the pack documents metrics ingestion or a way to pivot between signals using shared context such as trace IDs. Missing for 10: documented metrics collection, documented cross-signal pivoting/correlation between logs, traces, and metrics, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can collect metrics, logs, and traces in one platform and pivot between them with shared context

citations.quote: Sentry can ingest OpenTelemetry traces and logs via OTLP endpoints, either directly from an OTel SDK or through a pipeline tool like the OpenTelemetry Collector.
You can now explore span samples, visualize span attributes, and aggregate your data with flexible queries and filters.
